name: Bargaining rules: carrying capacity under two price rules
description: Chapter IV note 15: carrying capacity (mean population over ticks 200–300) against mean vision in iv-3-trade's ({G₁}, {M, T}) market, priced by the book's geometric mean √(MRS_A·MRS_B) and by a price drawn uniformly from [MRS_A, MRS_B]. A mean of m is the uniform range 1–(2m−1). Seeds 1–10. Measured (release, seeds 1–10): geometric mean 41.8 at vision 1 and 76.6 at vision 6; random 41.7 and 75.5; the largest (|d| + 2 se) relative to the geometric-mean line is 0.190, so the book test's tolerance is τ = 0.20 of the geometric-mean line.
